name: FOLD
tagline: A cake studio. Commissions, priced on the page.
taxNote: Includes 7% VAT, the reduced German rate for prepared food.
_commission: The numbers a real studio keeps in its head and never puts on the site. Every one of them is quoted back to the customer on the spec sheet.

commission.note: One of us builds it, start to finish. That is why the diary is short and the notice is long.

delivery.note: Driven flat and level across Berlin, and set up on site if the piece needs it.

allergenStatement: One kitchen, one bench. It handles gluten, dairy, egg, nuts and soya, and we cannot promise any piece is free of them. Tell us about an allergy in the brief and we will tell you honestly whether we can work around it.

voice.headline: Priced on the page.
voice.lede: Every other studio takes your brief and sends a number in a week. Write it here and the figure moves as you go — firm for fourteen days, deposit at the end.
